subject: Variance of residual in two-level bernoulli model

messages.author: 59a171c2b8a2dd5a
messages.subject: Variance of residual in two-level bernoulli model
parts:
Dears,

I have built up a two-level model and want to calculate the variance of residual of the model. I used the code below to estimate the coefficients of each variables and calculate the variance of residual, just wander if it is right since the variance of residual ("res.distr") is very small.

> bformula<-bf("Response ~ Sex + Age + Ethnic + (1 | DISTRICT)")
> brm.distr0 <- brm(bformula1, data=cmb.data, family=bernoulli(link = "logit"), threshold="flexible", warmup = 2000, iter = 4000, chains = 4, cores=4, thin=4, control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99, max_treedepth=15))
> res<-residuals(brm.distr0, summary = TRUE)
> head(res)
    Estimate  Est.Error    2.5%ile    97.5%ile
1 -0.1186326 0.04645570 -0.2252376 -0.04729413
2  0.6519298 0.10003030  0.4424235  0.82645704
3 -0.3313294 0.10216314 -0.5487934 -0.15236042
4  0.5296493 0.08910863  0.3549354  0.70605870
5 -0.2945145 0.08110868 -0.4621049 -0.15554942
6  0.6792528 0.08773110  0.4876536  0.83227171
>res.distr<-mean(res[,2]^2)
[1] 0.004125308

Thanks and regards.

Diva
